column3: Disabling a model moves every conversation on it (home chat, coordinators and Captains, threads) to the default its role resolves to (project, then owner), applied by models.enable itself; with no default left the model is cleared so the next turn asks for one; a model that is an owner or project role default cannot be disabled; every path that picks a model (conv.configure, set_model, models.list, owner.defaults, project.update, captain.create/update, delegate_task incl. its parent fallback, thread.create, thread.side) refuses a disabled one through ModelsService.disabled
column4: Bosun decision: conversations on a disabled model switch to their role default at their next turn and new threads never inherit it; moving them eagerly at the toggle costs one commit per affected conversation once, instead of a check on every request
